Write_error_log_row.description: This description is deliberately far longer than Power Automate's hard 256-character limit on any action, trigger, trigger-parameter or trigger-schema-property description field. It exists so the gate that enforces C-TECH-049 can be proven capable of failing, which is the whole point of a known-bad fixture and was the gap that let three separate gates in this build report PASS while reading nothing at all.
